The fabric hangs loosely and does not cling to the body, effectively obscuring the wearer's torso shape.

Distinct black vertical panels (likely velvet) run along the front edges of the yellow gown, serving as the visual closure elements.
A white collared shirt is visible through the front opening, consistent with formal attire worn under academic regalia.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
